mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_verifications ( id, user_id, business_registration_number, representative_name, opening_date, business_status_code, business_status_name, verified_at, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{businessRegistrationNumber}, #{representativeName}, #{openingDate}, #{businessStatusCode}, #{businessStatusName}, #{verifiedAt}, #{expiresAt}, NULL, NOW(6) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, business_registration_number, representative_name, opening_date, business_status_code, business_status_name, verified_at, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at FROM business_verifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND business_registration_number = #{businessRegistrationNumber} AND representative_name = #{representativeName} AND opening_date = #{openingDate} AND business_status_code = '01' AND expires_at > #{now} AND consumed_at IS NULL ORDER BY expires_at DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, business_registration_number, representative_name, opening_date, business_status_code, business_status_name, verified_at, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at FROM business_verifications WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
